entries.final_answer: Projects picker is outside the shell (no shell, no side rail). Shell has two layouts: project (one sidebar, no rail: Missions, Drift, Ops) and mission (rail + mission sidebar: Pipeline, Work Packages, Artifacts). Where sk-app-shell cannot express a layout, build it locally on sk-* primitives and record the gap for the design library.
